QuestInfo.name: Chaos Rising
QuestInfo.0: Princess Sakuno sent a letter not long after you sent her the report on Mitsuhide's scheme. Take a look.
QuestInfo.1: Princess Sakuno says Mitsuhide must be stopped at all costs. But how?
QuestInfo.2: Nobunaga and Ranmaru are threatening Maple World. All you can do right now is train until you're strong enough to stop Nobunaga and protect Princess Sakuno. It's time to pull out all the stops!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,536,020 Can proceed to the Unexpected Message quest

0.0: Dear loyal subject, I received your report. You have uncovered a plot none could predict. Akechi Mitsuhide is a traitor to us all, even Nobunaga.
0.1: However, it matters little whether Mitsuhide works of his own accord. Both he and Nobunaga must be stopped.
0.2: Do not let this new development faze your resolve. You must keep your focus to unravel the enemy's plan.
0.3: Haruaki and I will deal with the confusion in Momijigaoka. You focus on saving the world. - Sakuno

1.0: The princess is right. It doesn't matter who I face. All evil must be banished from Maple World.
1.1: I won't let the problems of my people infect Maple World. I have no choice but to take down anyone who gets in my way...
1.2: Then, and only then, shall I return to Sokoku.
